# Exact binary patch tables for `AppleIntel830` (generated by tools/gen_patch_tables.py)

All offsets are **file offsets** into the kext executable (`Contents/MacOS/AppleIntel830`); for `__text` code the virtual address used in the docs is `file offset - 732` (0x2dc). Runs closer than 8 bytes are merged; long runs (code caves) are truncated - the generator scripts `abi-port/mk_p45.py` ... `mk_p52` contain the full commented source.

Apple's binaries are **not** included in this repository. The chain starts at the output of the ABI translation stage (`abiport.py`) applied to the DTK 10.4.1 kext.
